title: Storage Rental Holding Limits per Lease
content:
One Apartment Home Lease may hold at most two Storage Rentals, within a per-product cap and a combined floor-area cap.

## The rule

A lease may hold up to **2** Storage Rentals across all storage products, and up to each product's own maximum number of rentals per lease; and the combined floor area in square feet of the lease's storage rentals may not exceed **125 square feet**. Reserved rentals count toward every cap. A storage reservation is made only while the lease is active.

## What is counted

The holdings measured against the caps are the lease's storage rentals whose status is **reserved, active, overlocked or notice given**. For each, the product's floor area is added to the lease total, and the rentals are counted in total and per product. A rental whose status is vacated or cancelled is not in that set.

The three caps apply together:

| Cap | Limit | Measured on |
|---|---|---|
| Rentals per lease, all storage products | 2 | Count of counted rentals |
| Rentals per lease of one product | That product's maximum per lease (2 for the Bike Storage Locker, 1 for each other product) | Count of counted rentals of that product |
| Combined floor area | 125 square feet, not to be exceeded | Sum of the products' square feet over counted rentals |

## The lease must be active

A storage reservation is made only while the lease is active. The basis is the lease's status in the system record, for the lease the rental attaches to; a caller's own description of the lease does not stand in for that record.

## Worked combinations (hypothetical leases)

Floor areas: Bike Storage Locker 12, Small Storage Closet (4x4) 16, Standard Storage Unit (5x5) 25, Large Storage Unit (5x10) 50, Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) 50, Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) 100 square feet.

| Lease already holds | Product requested | Rentals after | Floor area after | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nothing counted | Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | 1 | 100 | Within all caps |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10), active | Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | 2 | 125 | Within all caps (125 equals the limit and does not exceed it) |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10), active | Large Storage Unit (5x10) | 2 | 150 | Exceeds the floor-area cap |
| Bike Storage Locker, reserved | A second Bike Storage Locker | 2 | 24 | Within all caps (the reserved locker counts) |
| Two Bike Storage Lockers, active | Small Storage Closet (4x4) | 3 | 40 | Exceeds the 2-rental cap |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10), active | Another Large Storage Unit (5x10) | 2 | 100 | Exceeds that product's cap of 1 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10), vacated | Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | 1 | 50 | Within all caps (the vacated rental is not counted) |

## Basis questions

**Does a unit that is only reserved use up a place?** Yes. Reserved rentals count toward every cap, the rental count and the floor area alike.

**Does an overlocked unit, or one under notice, still count?** Yes. Overlocked and notice-given rentals are in the counted set.

**Is exactly 125 square feet allowed?** Yes. The combined floor area may not exceed 125 square feet; a total equal to 125 does not exceed it.
